name: r6-totem-kill
description: THE TOTEM FIGHT — the ladder's FIRST boss kill, and the first {43,5} written by the game's own removed(). Boots into L43's SOUTH chamber (the unwoken boss is an 80x32 Solid across the whole arena, so a north boot can never reach the wand at all) with the five totem parts presented by the v6 save block, walks north into wand@144,224, pays the 99-frame approach fade and the 150-frame specialTimer, advances the two-page dialogue, and the wand's tset-0 publish drops the three fallrocks — 186 more frozen frames — and takes classCount(Wand) to 0, which is the boss's wake edge. 148 model ticks later the machine walks. Then the fight: the stance stands at x 131.5, west of the laser's FIXED [135,169) band (the boss's x never changes — knockback is overridden empty), and tracks the 0.75 px/tick descent (v.y = rate, MINUS Mobile's 0.25 friction) with an eight-tick down burst per 22-tick cycle, so the offset D = playerY - bossY stays in [48.6, 97.6]: clear of the 80x32 body from below (D >= 46), inside the wand's 16 px spawn plus 48 px of flight (D < 110), and outside the death blast's origin-to-origin r=52 disc at the kill (66.06 px). THE DESCENT AND THE SHOT FIGHT OVER ONE FIELD — direction is written by sprites() from v, so every tracking down turns the wand south; the cycle holds the eight ticks after each press clear and re-faces north with a ONE-TICK up tap two ticks before the next. Ten presses at a 22-tick cadence land ten shots (0.5 damage against hitsMax 5) at 221/244/265/287/309/331/353/377/398/419, every one clearing the boss's own 20-tick hitsTimer; the tenth is the kill. The laser fires once, at 315, and MISSES — which is the exactness claim and not a lucky miss — and Game.shake = 30 opens the permanent camera band anyway. The attack's two BossTotemShots spawn at x 122 and 182 with D at 60.6, so both fall away below the stance. removed() runs 240 white-out renders and one updateLists() after the kill: {43,5} lands at tick 660, and the tape runs 120 ticks past it, at rest.
